name: Latent Voxel Auto-Encoder
definition: A hierarchical auto-encoder that encodes the voxel grid V (concatenated density and features) into three latents: 1D global latent g, 3D coarse latent c, and 2D fine latent f, using 2D CNNs.
summary: The Latent Voxel Auto-Encoder compresses 3D voxel grids into a hierarchical latent space using 2D CNNs to separate global properties from local details, solving dimensionality bottlenecks in diffusion models.
